id: AT-STATE-ROOT-06 (state-root: migrate's copy never leaves a cut-off file; a new root inside the old one is not copied into itself)
note: State root (0.1.2): util::copy_new, migrate's copy, writes under a temp name beside the file and links it into place: a write that fails part way leaves nothing under the file's name and no temp name, a rerun copies it, the mtime given is kept, and an existing file is never replaced; through migrate too (STORE_TEST_COPY_FAIL_AFTER, test mode: a disk that fills part way), with exit 3 and the file copied whole by the next run. migrate skips the new root when it lies inside the old one ($XDG_STATE_HOME under ~/.claude/trash-staging), so nothing is copied into itself. A source missing while the file is there is left alone without being opened; a file that appears under the name while the copy runs is never replaced (link, not rename); a source that grows while it is copied (a session still writing it; STORE_TEST_COPY_GROW_AFTER in test mode) fails with exit 3 and nothing under its name, and the next run copies it whole. A new root the unsafe-root checks refuse gets nothing, exit 3.
